items.docs: Returns a list of all S3 buckets owned by the authenticated user in the Ceph Object Storage gateway. The response includes bucket names and creation dates. Credentials are provided via AWS Signature Version 4 or Version 2 authentication using access keys provisioned by CephObjectStoreUser CRDs.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the S3 bucket in the Ceph Object Storage gateway. Must be globally unique within the object store and follow DNS naming conventions.

items.docs: Creates a new S3 bucket in the Ceph Object Storage gateway with the specified name. The bucket is created in the object store backing pool configured in the CephObjectStore CRD. Optional location constraint and ACL headers can be specified in the request.

items.docs: Deletes an empty S3 bucket from the Ceph Object Storage gateway. The bucket must be empty before it can be deleted. Returns HTTP 409 if the bucket is not empty.

params.name: bucket

items.docs: Checks whether a bucket exists and whether the caller has permission to access it. Returns HTTP 200 if the bucket exists and is accessible, HTTP 403 if the bucket exists but access is denied, or HTTP 404 if the bucket does not exist.

params.name: list-type
params.description: Set to 2 to use the newer List Objects V2 API which uses continuation tokens instead of markers for pagination.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Limits the response to keys beginning with the specified prefix. Used to organize objects into virtual directories.

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Character used to group keys. All keys that contain the delimiter between the prefix and the first occurrence of the delimiter are grouped into a single CommonPrefix entry.

params.name: max-keys
params.description: Maximum number of keys to return in a single response. Defaults to 1000, maximum is 1000.

params.name: continuation-token
params.description: Token from a previous List Objects V2 response used to continue listing from where the previous call left off.

params.name: marker
params.description: Key after which listing should begin, used for pagination in List Objects V1 API.

items.docs: Returns a list of objects stored in the specified S3 bucket. Supports filtering by prefix, delimiter for hierarchical listings, and pagination through continuation tokens. Returns up to 1000 objects per request by default.

params.name: key
params.description: Object key (path) within the bucket. Can include forward slashes to simulate a directory hierarchy, with a maximum length of 1024 bytes.

items.docs: Downloads the data and metadata of an object from the specified key in the S3 bucket. Supports range requests for partial content retrieval and conditional requests using ETag or Last-Modified headers. Returns the object data in the response body.
